scientific_integrity: The claimed contribution is the explicit next coefficient under the stated relative sphere-area asymptotic \(S(r)=Cr^k e^{hr}(1+O(r^{-1}))\). The radial capacity identity and the rank-detecting logarithmic coefficient are established literature; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires \(S(r)=Cr^k e^{hr}(1+O(r^{-1}))\) with fixed positive \(h,C\) and fixed \(R>0\); no conclusion for general non-radial manifolds or when only two-sided growth bounds are known.
title: Next-order large-\(p\) capacity asymptotics for model manifolds
